summary: Backend-only test of the 3 new 'Jeton Café' countdown campaign endpoints in /app/backend/routes/campaign.py. Created /app/backend/tests/test_countdown_campaign.py (12 pytest cases, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter30_countdown.xml). All 12 tests PASS on the public preview URL. Auth via artisan@mesurechassis.fr/artisan123. Endpoints verified: GET /api/campaign/countdown/list (401 without auth, correct 31-day payload with j_zero_date=2026-08-12, today, today_day, campaign_active, days[] ordered n=30→n=0, publish_date strictly +1 day, all 3 captions per day non-empty, status past/today/future consistent with today_day); GET /api/campaign/countdown/visual/{n} (PUBLIC, valid n=0/15/30 → 200 image/png >10KB with PNG magic bytes, n=99 → 404, no auth header still returns 200); GET /api/campaign/countdown/zip (401 without auth, 200 application/zip with auth, size ~1.27MB > 500KB, ZIP contains exactly 31 PNGs + captions.json, valid PK header). No code changes made — all endpoints behave exactly as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: campaign.py is 1019 lines (>700 line guideline). Non-blocking for this feature, but the module now mixes prospection/RGPD/countdown concerns — consider splitting countdown routes into /app/backend/routes/campaign_countdown.py in a future refactor.

The 3 new countdown endpoints use `os.path` (sync) I/O inside async handlers — acceptable for small file checks, but for consistency with the rest of the codebase (aiofiles/asyncio.to_thread) consider offloading if files grow.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing PNG/ZIP artifacts already generated in /app/backend/public_downloads/countdown/ (31 PNGs, captions.json, countdown_v1.zip).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_countdown_campaign.py is idempotent, uses EXPO_BACKEND_URL and owner credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (artisan@mesurechassis.fr / artisan123). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_countdown_campaign.py -v --no-cov`. Coverage threshold (80%) in pytest.ini will fail if run without --no-cov since these tests focus on 3 endpoints only.
